HOW TO IMPORT INTO ASEPRITE & SAVE AS .ASEPRITE
════════════════════════════════════════════════

Step 1 — Open a PNG
  File → Open → select any PNG from the /PNG folder
  (e.g. 01_torii_gate_32x32.png)

Step 2 — Verify canvas size
  Make sure the canvas is 32x32 px.
  Go to Edit → Canvas Size if needed.

Step 3 — Load the color palette
  Window → Palettes → click the "..." icon → Load Palette
  Select: feudal_japan_palette.gpl

Step 4 — Add layers (optional)
  Layer panel → click "+" to add a new layer.
  Useful for creating animation frames or color variants.

Step 5 — Save as Aseprite source file
  File → Save As → choose format "Aseprite (*.aseprite)"
  Suggested name: feudal_japan_props.aseprite

Step 6 — Re-export to PNG (optional)
  File → Export Sprite Sheet
  → Type: Packed / By Rows
  → Output: PNG

────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Tips for creating Vol.2 directly in Aseprite:
  - Start from a blank 32x32 canvas
  - Use separate layers for: shadow, base color, detail
  - Load the palette before you start drawing
  - Save as .aseprite first, export PNG when done
────────────────────────────────────────────────
